To help you test your assumption regarding delivery speed, here is a draft guide for your first five interviews.

**Questions to ask students**
* "Can you walk me through what you ate for dinner the last time you were studying on campus in the evening?"
* "What other options did you consider before deciding on that specific meal?"

Conduct 5 interviews with graduate students currently studying on campus. Focus on their recent actual behavior and alternatives to identify if "speed" is truly the primary pain point or if cost or variety is more significant. Record which specific friction points they mention when describing their last meal.
